attackers_goals: Adversaries may collect ML artifacts for exfiltration or for use in ML Attack Staging.
description: A model artifact was accessed from cloud storage by an identity that typically doesn't interact with model files. MITRE ATLAS Technique: AML.T0035 - ML Artifact Collection.
investigative_actions: Examine the bucket to determine which model was accessed. Verify that this command was executed by a trusted source.
name: Suspicious ML Model Download
